(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)

  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

Starter Rito Ihara gave that early lead strong support. He pitched five innings, allowed only two hits, and gave up one run. Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth, when Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run.

But that home run did not change the game. Hanshin added runs in the seventh and eighth innings. The lead grew, and Hiroshima could not close the gap.

The final score was Hanshin 8, Hiroshima 1.

【Point One】

So Hanshin did not depend only on Sato’s early home run. The team built its final margin step by step, with help from a player off the bench.

【Point Two】
Ihara’s part is clear: five innings, two hits, and one run. That gave Hanshin a strong base for the game.

But the confirmed record does not say which Hanshin pitchers worked the sixth through the ninth innings or how those innings were handled. The safe reading is simple: Ihara gave the team a strong start, and the victory belonged to Hanshin as a team.
